## 2026-05-11

### Impact

- Adds a headless mode for action tasks, letting integrators run an action without presenting Transact UI.

### Changes

- Add `actionType` to `TaskStatusUpdate` so consumers can tell which action (`refresh`, `connect-account`, `disconnect-account`, `switch`, `cancel-plan`, `pause-plan`) succeeded or failed
- Add support for headless actions: new `headless` option on action configuration is now passed through to Transact (#181, #182)
- Set the Transact `publicToken` on the webview's `window` for more secure token handling 

### Products

- Deposit
- Switch
- Manage

### Requirements

#### Latest

| Name       | Compatible | Build Version |
| ---------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin     | 2.0+       | 2.1.21        |
| Gradle     | 8.7+       | 8.7           |
| AGP        | 8.6+       | 8.6.1         |
| Min SDK    | 23         | 23            |
| Target SDK | 35         | 35            |

#### Legacy (`-kotlin1.9`)

| Name       | Compatible | Build Version |
| ---------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin     | 1.9.x      | 1.9.25        |
| Gradle     | 8.0+       | 8.7           |
| AGP        | 8.1 - 8.5  | 8.1.4         |
| Min SDK    | 23         | 23            |
| Target SDK | 35         | 35            |
